summary: Fed officials signalled patience on further rate cuts as inflation cools slowly, keeping the rate outlook in focus for US stocks. Wall Street ended the week mixed with tech stocks weighing on the Nasdaq, and Nvidia shares slipped after a report of tighter chip export rules. Elsewhere, Tesla deliveries beat analyst estimates and Microsoft and Amazon expanded their AI data center plans.
story1_why: Signals about the pace of rate cuts shape borrowing costs and how investors value stocks across the market.
story2_why: Tighter export rules could limit where Nvidia can sell its chips.
